nameOrigin: thin strand of metal used to conduct electricity

pokedexEntries.dp: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

pokedexEntries.pt: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.

pokedexEntries.hgss: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

pokedexEntries.bw: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.

pokedexEntries.x: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

pokedexEntries.or: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

pokedexEntries.y: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

pokedexEntries.as: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

pokedexEntries.su: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

pokedexEntries.mo: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

pokedexEntries.us: It grips its tail, which spews electricity, and then beats down opponents with the power of its electrified fist.

pokedexEntries.um: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

pokedexEntries.sw: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

pokedexEntries.sh: In terms of electrical-energy output, Electivire is one of the best among all Electric Pokémon. It discharges high-voltage currents from its tails.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of electricity.

pokedexEntries.la: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.
